paper_citation: P.E.A. Turchi, L. Kaufman, Zi-Kui Liu, Modeling of Ni–Cr–Mo based alloys: Part I—phase stability, Calphad 30, 70-87 (2006).
quote: This experimental work indicates that a Ni-25 at.% Cr-8.33 at.% Mo alloy has a maximum critical order-disorder temperature for the oP6 to fcc transition on heating of about 670 ◦ C, as compared with a maximum transition temperature of 570 ◦ C for a Ni-33.3 at.% Cr alloy.
